item.title: Healthy Living: Heart health awareness for women
item.description: Recent research shows a link between menopause and heart issues, and here to break down the data is Dr. Patricia Egwuatu, family medicine doctor at Kaiser Permanente Capitol Hill Medical Center.

item.title: Megan Keller's OT goal delivers gold medal to U.S. in 2-1 win over Canada in women's hockey
item.description: The United States has won its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey. Megan Keller backhanded in a shot 4:07 into overtime, and the Americans beat Canada 2-1 at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: ORCA launching contactless 'Tap to Pay' for light rail, buses in WA. Here's when
item.description: Starting Feb. 23, Puget Sound transit riders can ditch the ORCA card and use credit cards or digital wallets. See where "Tap to Pay" works and how it affects fares.

item.title: Seattle weather: Cold air Thursday, drier Friday
item.description: Looking ahead, Friday morning will start cold again with many locations dipping below freezing. Skies remain mostly dry Friday with increasing clouds by daybreak.

item.title: Man charged in arson, assault at Seattle's Harborview Medical Center
item.description: A man accused of starting a fire inside a room at Seattle's Harborview Medical Center and assaulting staff and security has been formally charged.

item.title: High profile bills in Olympia, WA die with just weeks to go
item.description: Measures that died include proposals on initiatives, a 32-hour workweek, ICE hiring restrictions, encampment sweep rules and a marijuana tax hike.

item.title: Democrat policy researchers develop plan to cap grocery prices
item.description: Grocery prices continue to be a major strain on household budgets. A new proposal from national policy researchers aims to bring food costs down, giving families some relief at the checkout line.

item.title: Inside Mike Macdonald’s decision to trust Brian Fleury as new Seattle Seahawks offensive coordinator
item.description: Mike Macdonald hires Brian Fleury as Seahawks offensive coordinator, trusting his Shanahan-system roots, analytics background and leadership despite no prior offensive play-calling experience.

item.title: Thieves break into popular West Seattle taco restaurant, owners say losses go beyond cash
item.description: Thieves were caught on camera breaking into a popular restaurant along Alki in West Seattle on Wednesday. No cash was taken, but the owners say the impact is already being felt.

item.title: Westside Neighbors Shelter helping people who 'weren't expecting' extreme cold
item.description: Shelter leaders say the cold snap and a recent camp cleanup increased demand, with more people seeking refuge.
